title: Kestrel Care Holder Points on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Late-Posted Installment Charge
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — customers who hold a Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract.**

**Rule.** When the customer holds an active Kestrel Care plan financed in this contract, 0.5 percentage points are taken off the late-posted rate; when the customer holds an active Kestrel Care plan financed some other way, 0.25 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

A Kestrel Care plan here is the customer's Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract in active status. It is financed in this contract when the Care contract's record shows this retail contract's account number as the account it is financed in; an active Care plan whose record shows another financing account, or none, is financed some other way.

The points come off the late-posted rate that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to one monthly payment.

## Judgement

| Active Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract of the customer | Financing account on the Care record | Points taken off |
|---|---|---|
| yes | this retail contract's account number | 0.5 |
| yes | another account, or none | 0.25 |
| no | — | 0 |

*Hypothetical:* a customer whose only active Care plan shows no financing account on its record takes 0.25 points off.
